name: Antoine Bosselut
one_sentence_summary: Antoine Bosselut leads the EPFL NLP Lab, researching knowledge representation, commonsense reasoning, and language generation, with recent work spanning open multimodal LLMs (Apertus), test-time training for reasoning consolidation, multilingual/multimodal evaluation, and LLM-brain alignment.
matrix_summary: Antoine Bosselut's lab released two major items since the last update: **Apertus 1.5** (Oct 2026), extending Switzerland's fully open LLM to multimodal reasoning (image + audio, 262K context), and **TTT-Consolidate** accepted at **NeurIPS 2026**, which uses test-time training to consolidate multi-agent reasoning trajectories and beats baselines by up to 20 points on math benchmarks. A second PhD student (Angelika Romanou) also graduated, and three additional papers were accepted at ICML 2026.
